responsibility: Declares the expression-and-statement BIR builder that visits Rust HIR executable constructs and produces a resulting BIR place. It defines the public build entry point plus the large set of HIR visitor hooks for expressions and statements, and serves as the interface layer for the main executable-code lowering component, distinct from the shared builder infrastructure and the specialized lazy-boolean, pattern-binding, and struct-initializer builders.
same_name_distinction: Provides the borrowck interface for ExprStmtBuilder by declaring the class, its build entry point, and the full set of HIR visit hooks for expression/statement lowering; unlike the companion .cc file, it does not implement the lowering, only exposes the builder’s shape and helpers.
